name: CaseStep
caption: Case

edges.rules: One edge per explicit branch, edge.value = the match value and edge.description = the branch label, followed by exactly one default edge with the reserved value "__default__" as the LAST edge. configuration.branches must list the explicit edge values, i.e. every edge value except "__default__", as strings. At runtime the resolved configuration.value is matched exactly and case-sensitively against configuration.branches. On a match, the edge with that value is taken. Otherwise the "__default__" edge is taken. An edge whose value is not in 'branches' is unreachable. A 'branches' entry without an edge, or an edge with no steps, continues after the Case step.

configuration.description: The value to route on. Supports SmartFields {{..}}, SmartFormulas [[..]] and SmartControls {#..#}. Resolved before matching.

Array of strings: the explicit branch match values, in edge order, without '__default__'. Written by the editor from the branch list (rows with an empty match value are dropped). If this key is absent, the step runs in legacy mode: it emits the raw value with no default routing, so an unmatched value continues after the Case step and the '__default__' edge is never taken.

rules.check: configuration.value must be non-empty (required field in the configuration dialog)
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

notes: The 'result' output is the matched value, or '__default__' when nothing matches. It is what the engine routes on.
Matching is exact text equality and case-sensitive. There is no trimming or numeric comparison: '1' does not match '1.0'.

An empty resolved value goes to the default branch. An explicit empty-string entry in 'branches' (possible only in hand-written JSON) makes the step emit '' instead, and the engine never routes on an empty value: the flow continues after the Case step and no branch runs.
Nothing checks for duplicate branch values or for a user branch that uses '__default__'. Avoid both: only the first edge with a given value is ever taken.
Edge values are matched with a quoted path expression. Avoid single quotes (') in branch values.
The engine stores the routed value in a 100-character field. Keep branch values to 100 characters or fewer.
Outputs of steps inside a branch are deleted when control leaves the branch.
